safety.exposure: Hard; open fjärds, outer skerries, route highly weather-dictated.

campingRules: Bird-protection zones around Rödlöga/Svartlöga noted in route logs; verify current dates and boundaries.

protectionRules.summary: Outer northern route through Svartlöga/Rödlöga/Röder/Norrpada-type skerries; verify protected-area and bird/säl closures before landing or close approaches.

generalRules.rule: Do not disturb or damage nature; avoid private zones and sensitive bird/wildlife areas.
Nature reserves, national parks, bird/säl protection areas and municipal reserves can restrict camping, fires, dogs, landing and anchoring.
Always check current Stockholm County fire bans before using any stove, grill or open fire.

routeSegments.appliesTo: Svartlöga, Rödlöga, Röder and outer skerries
rules: Avoid landing on small bird-rich skerries without official confirmation.
Check Skyddad natur and charts for seasonal bird/säl protection zones before routing.
